reviews.review: Great developers who listen to the community and are not afraid to give us goodies. VERY fun combat and huge variety of weapons and frames, I enjoy every minute in Warframe.

I've played since early september 2013, and if you asked me to recommend this game anytime since then pre-railjack, it would of been a hesitant yes. This has been a game I've poured more money into cosmetics than I am willing to admit, and spent long hours shilling hard to my friends desperately trying to convey just how much potential this game had. I say had because DE, over the past two to three years, has proven that they don't know how to capitalize on that potential the most. They may do regular devstreams, but they are remarkably unable to actually give veterans a meaningful update or meaningful content, Their nerf happiness seems out of place in a power fantasy PvE horde shooter, and time and time again it shows that their team is carried by a few people with everyone else actively hurting the game at worst, and contributing basically nothing at best. This isn't even covering disasters like chat moderation being some of the worst, over-reaching garbage I've ever seen, the general unhelpfulness of support a good 80% of the time for almost everyone I've talked to about this game (Though I was quite lucky to have my only experience with support be quite pleasant), and the many MANY other problems this game has that any number of people covers far far better than I do.
I've fallen out of love with this game, and it hurts to leave a negative review on a game I have so many hours in, spent so much money on, and spent so much time of the past seven years adoring and swallowing my disagreement with the direction certain things have gone over the potential this game used to have in my eyes. It's a great power fantasy game, and still a decent free game that apparently had it's new player experience improved again, but I won't be revisiting this one (If I do and things have improved then I'll amend this review). It was fun, Tenno.

My last review was just over two years ago. The fact that they still want to call this game a 'beta' is a bit laughable. Thoroughly enjoying this game, though I haven't tested it online thus far with friends. Their last complaint was the ping, I THINK they have servers now in Africa? It states I'm in AF. Some of my complaints such as the need to filter pricing/price type still exists and a new complaint is that items in the market are somewhat vague at times. Nevertheless, this is a game I plan to play for a really long time.


The old review:
Think Mass Effect but with ZERO cover base shooting, and human sized robots. Bit of a fun game, nice concept and animations. If you can move past the gooey interface (IT REALLY NEEDS A SORT BY PRICING OPTIONS) and awkward controls (I really suggest you rebind them) it'll be fun with friends.
Amazing non-stop progressive game play with top of the line graphics and constantly improving interface(s).
